concerns.text: FR-015 mandates dynamically raising the functional‑connectivity correlation threshold (up to 0.7) until the functional adjacency graph becomes fully connected. Because the global functional connectivity strength predictor (mean absolute correlation) is computed on this thresholded graph, the predictor is a data‑dependent transformation of the same data used in the mediation model. This introduces a circular, post‑hoc selection of the predictor that can bias the indirect‑effect estimate and inflate type‑I error unless the threshold‑selection process is explicitly modelled or accounted for (e.g., via pre‑registration of a fixed threshold or a nested cross‑validation). The current design does not specify such correction, making the mediation analysis methodologically unsound.
